prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1487; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain and stiffness. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the impact. Over the course of 18 office visits, the patient received conservative management including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching program instruction. Treatment duration was somewhat longer than typical for uncomplicated cervical and lumbar strain, and progress was gradual. Physical examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, which support the diagnosis of soft tissue injury. Neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and strength, was within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical or lumbar regions is documented in the patient's history. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplicate or repeated charges for services rendered. Patient continues to report intermittent discomfort; further reassessment is planned.
